zh.title: SKYTICAL 團隊
zh.description: 認識 SKYTICAL 創辦人 nwe，以及這個由一人獨立營運、免費分享航空新聞的網站背後的故事。
zh.heading: 航空世界很大，從一份好奇開始。
zh.name: nwe
zh.role: 創辦人・首席網站營運與維護顧問
zh.intro: 你好，我是 nwe。從自己想看的新聞網站開始，SKYTICAL 慢慢成為與大家分享航空大小事的地方。
zh.photoAlt: SKYTICAL 創辦人 nwe 的個人照片
zh.photoCaption: 航空、攝影、音樂，還有路上的風景。

sections.title: 從自己想看的新聞網站開始
body: 我一直對航空業發生的大小事充滿興趣，但航空資訊往往散落在各家航空公司、各國民航主管機關與媒體之間。許多消息又具有時效性，等到偶然看到時，可能早已錯過最值得關注的時刻。
因此，我建立了 SKYTICAL，希望透過全自動新聞聚合，將分散的航空消息整理在一起，免費提供給讀者，讓大家更方便掌握航空界的重要動態、產業消息，以及令人好奇的話題與幕後故事。
最初，這只是一個做給自己看的新聞網站。隨著功能逐漸增加，網站也越來越實用，我才開始希望將它分享給更多讀者，以及同樣關心航空世界的朋友。

sections.title: 一個人營運，也持續往前
body: 從網站開發、功能規劃，到日常營運、更新與維護，目前都由我一人負責。
身為學生，能投入的時間有限，但我會持續在課業與網站之間找到平衡，盡力讓 SKYTICAL 保持更新、穩定運作，也讓每一次調整都更貼近讀者的需要。

sections.title: 航空之外的我
body: 目前是一名大學生。比起單純以「航空迷」介紹自己，我更覺得自己是對國內外整個航空產業都充滿好奇的愛好者。
航空之外，我也喜歡攝影、音樂與旅遊。最近尤其沉迷於 neo-soul，常聽 Frank Ocean 和 Daniel Caesar，讓音樂陪著自己度過日常，也陪著網站一點一點成長。

zh.closing: 謝謝你來到 SKYTICAL，一起關心航空世界的下一件事。

en.title: SKYTICAL Team
en.description: Meet nwe, the founder behind SKYTICAL, an independently operated website sharing aviation news free of charge.
en.heading: A world of aviation. A spark of curiosity.
en.name: nwe
en.role: Founder · Chief Website Operations & Maintenance Consultant
en.intro: Hi, I'm nwe. What began as a news website I wanted to read has gradually become a place to share the aviation world with others.
en.photoAlt: Portrait of nwe, founder of SKYTICAL
en.photoCaption: Aviation, photography, music, and the places along the way.

sections.title: It started with the news I wanted to read
body: I've always been curious about what's happening across aviation. But the information is scattered among airlines, civil aviation authorities around the world, and the media. Much of it is time-sensitive; by the time I happened to find a story, the moment to follow it had often passed.

That's why I built SKYTICAL: a fully automated news aggregator that brings those scattered updates together, free for readers. I wanted to make it easier to keep up with major developments, industry news, interesting conversations, and the stories behind them.
At first, this was simply a news website for myself. As its features grew and it became more useful, I began to want to share it with other readers and anyone equally curious about aviation.

sections.title: One person, keeping things moving
body: From development and feature planning to day-to-day operations, updates, and maintenance, I currently look after the whole website myself.
As a student, my time is limited. I'm working to balance my studies with the website, keeping SKYTICAL updated and running reliably, and making each improvement more useful to its readers.

sections.title: Beyond aviation
body: I'm currently a university student. Rather than simply calling myself an aviation fan, I think of myself as someone curious about the entire industry, both in Taiwan and abroad.

Outside aviation, I enjoy photography, music, and travel. Lately I've been especially drawn to neo-soul, with Frank Ocean and Daniel Caesar often on repeat as I go about my day and keep building this website.

en.closing: Thanks for being here. Let's keep following what happens next in aviation.
